name: Collatz River
desc: Hundreds of Collatz (3n+1) hailstone orbits braid out from a shared root into a luminous river-delta of coral strands, hued violet-young through cyan to gold-old with additive glow, swaying on incommensurate currents over deep glowing water.

density.doc: strand count in the delta (10..200 braided orbits)

energy.doc: glow + core brightness and glint intensity

hue.doc: rotates the orbit-length palette ramp + water

style.doc: render philosophy: violet-gold delta / teal-pink coral / ember autumn / deep-sea bioluminescent / flat sumi ink (mono)
